title: Ɔkra Dwo a Ɔwɔ Adiyifoɔ Mu
intro: Ɛnne bi a ɛfrɛ trenee nam Kur’aan Anuonyam no nkyekyem ahorow mu gyegye. Wɔmaa ɔkra a wɔahyira no yi nkɔmhyɛ ne ɔsoro kyerɛwsɛm wɔ berɛ a na akwankyerɛ ho hia paa wɔ Israel Mma no mu. Saa onipa yi kasa kyerɛɛ wɔn nkurɔfo tẽẽ, hyɛɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnkae wɔn Awurade. Ɛnam boasetɔ ne ahofama so bɛyɛɛ hann kanea a n’asɛm ma kyerɛw kronkron nkratafa hyerɛn. So wubetumi ahu saa onipa nwonwaso yi a wɔhyɛ ne din anuonyam wɔ Kur’aan ne Asɛmpa nyinaa mu no?
clues: Wɔde nkɔmhyɛni ne ɔsoro nwoma hyɛɛ me anuonyam wɔ me nkurɔfoɔ ahohia berɛ mu.
Me maame woo me wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nwonwa so, ɛnam Allah ɔsoro ahyɛdeɛ nko ara so.
Mekasa kyerɛɛ me nkurɔfoɔ se, ‘O Israel Mma! Mene Allah somafoa ma mo, a me si dee edii m'anim kan no so dua.'
Mede Nsenkyerennee a eda adi pefee firi w'Awurade ho bae, na mede anigyee nsem a efa odiyifoo bi a ne din beye Ahmad ho bae.
Na me maame yɛ ɔbaa teneneeni a ɔde me hyɛɛ Allah som mu firi me mmeranteberɛ mu.
Allah kyerɛkyerɛɛ me Kur’aan no na ɔmaa me ayamhyehyeɛ ne asɛdeɛ ma me maame, na na mennyɛ ahantan anaa asoɔdenfoɔ.

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍۢ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verse: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic." (61:6)
